It’s the only place I trust to take care of my dog. I bring him here every week for grooming, and I’ve also had his vaccinations and neutering done here.

All of the staff genuinely take such good care of my dog. They play with him while he’s waiting for grooming and even give him snacks. It’s clear they truly care about the pets and make them feel happy and comfortable. I highly recommend this place!

Absolutely thrilled with Pet Village & Salon! Our Australian shepherd is 7 years old and we have never had a groom look this good! She looks amazing, feels so clean, and smells so good! This was also our first time trusting a grooming service to pick up/ deliver for us and everything went very smoothly. We are happy with their services and will be back :) it was a 10/10 experience.
Probably the best pet shop and pet services in Chiangmai. Has Pet salon and Vet services. And I Guess a pet hotel to house your pet when u travel. Not much to complain of this place.
We really loved our cat, she was cute. She was adopted this Thursday. I hope she will be okay

This is my go-to clinic for my dog! The service is excellent, and the staff is incredibly kind and caring. They provide top-notch care at reasonable prices. Plus, they offer a pet salon, clinic, and hotel—all in one place. Highly recommended!
First time here with my yorkie and they did a good job. Came with a free bandana on him. So cute.

I have been bringing my three dogs here for many years. They're professional, polite, clean and honest. It's worth a 30 minute drive if you're not nearby. They're not over priced. It's a nice, boutique, upscale shop. If you're getting your animals bathed & groomed and don't want to spend a little extra money because you want them well cared for, bring them somewhere else. Everyone has their price points, and this place is well worth the extra baht.

After being told to come at a certain time, we arrived and were told bath and cut would take 3hours. Waited in a mainly empty store with 2 on their phones while groomers at the back were busy.  At the time they said it would be done, they said wait .5 - 2.5 hours longer. Dog's grooming results were good (1000B for a large dog). It seems to me the premium being paid is for the appearance of high quality service.

We just adopted a 5 month old Pomeranian puppy and brought him here for a check-up, grooming and supplies. The staff was wonderful and the vet spoke excellent English. The place was clean and they had everything we needed for our new dog. When we got our puppy, he was dirty, matted, and full of fleas and ticks. The grooming team took him right in and gave him a bath, haircut, and flea treatment. The vet gave him a thorough check-up and advised us of future treatments - vaccinations, monthly flea medicine, and dietary needs. We were really impressed with the care our little puppy received.
Good service and fair prices, plus pickup and  drop off available.
Took my dog they’re and they took care of it very well,but I don’t precooked it so the wait line was very long but overall it’s a very good salon where they take good care of your pets

Excellent service but.....
Entrances need care as it's easy to miss them.
One on the Hang Dong slip road on the road from the Superhighway. Big C over the road on the right.
If you miss it follow the slip road to the left and the next entrance is about 100m down with a large yellow sign.
We take all three of our dogs here and have always had a good experience.  Wry good groomers. They have plenty of pet food, treats and bedding too.
Nice and friendly staffs with lots of love and cares to my pet when staying pet village 👍 …
I went over 5 pet hospitals for my cat over 2 years. I have never seen one like this, a place with very enthusiastic vet, well-equipped, and low-price.
Very nice place for your pets. All inclusive just in one place for health, hotel grooming etc.
They are very knowledgeable and helpful. Service is quite quick too. Using Line is an option to get an appointment closer to your needs.
Very good pet shop in Hang Dong and easy to access. My two dogs come here for grooming every week.
Everything you can imagine under the same roof. Pet supplies, pet salon, and veterinary on site. Great staff and decent prices.
Very experienced in handling my dog,in grooming and doctor is very kind and gentle to the dog
Very good location
Recommended.  you get what you pay for.  The doctors and staff are patient and friendly.

This is a really lovely shop. The staff are very attentive and kind. I made an appointment to bathe my little Chujai and asked to leave her there until almost evening (I had urgent business). They even sent me a video of her back. So refreshing! The staff took care of her and played with her to keep her stress-free. I don't get to use her services often, but I'm always impressed. I love how attentive the staff are here. (This is a heartfelt compliment. 😊 When I got home and asked my little Chujai if she was well taken care of, she nodded and asked if she wanted to go again. She nodded, showing that she was truly comfortable here. Thank you so much.)

Appointments are required, but they were very punctual and the service was excellent!

The cat got a very clean wash and haircut, the price was reasonable, and they even gave us a cute little scarf as a gift!
Vaccine, booster, and grass jelly dessert!

This is considered one of the best pet grooming shops in Chiang Mai, with skilled groomers. The prices are reasonable, the service is excellent, and the dogs smell wonderful after their baths. The grooming techniques are quite good.

A great pet shop. You can board and bathe your pet. They even tie a small scarf around the pet after each bath. It's very cute. The store also has pet supplies. One-stop service. It's a good choice because it's close to home.

I regularly use this grooming service for my dog, but this time I was very disappointed. I had a reservation confirmed for noon, so I took my dog ​​in at 11 am. By 3:30 pm, there was still no update on whether the grooming was finished. I …
I took my little brother to get his hair cut. He's so handsome. The service is great. All the staff are lovely and very kind to him.
The staff were lovely, friendly, and very welcoming. They did a great job grooming the dog. Parking was convenient. I liked it!
Excellent service, friendly and cheerful. Teddy and Minnie were bathed, dressed up, and tied with bows; they looked gorgeous and adorable.
Everything you need for your cats and dogs: veterinary care, grooming, trimming, and boarding. We offer a complete range of services for pet lovers.
The staff were friendly and the shower fee was affordable.

I came to Chiang Mai with my dog. I booked via LINE and visited to receive a scissor cut and a basic bath, with the addition of medicated shampoo and brushing teeth. His face looks round and cute now. The booking consultation was friendly, so be sure to reserve your date and time in advance before visiting!

I took my dog ​​(a 4-month-old American bully) to daycare, gave him a bath, and flea medication.
The staff member said that next time, they wouldn't bathe him, but would just let him be daycare because he's fierce (I'd already informed them that he's playful, aggressive, and very aggressive).
I was disappointed because I usually give him a bath at other places (I pay for everything), and they didn't have any problems.
They don't seem like animal lovers and don't seem to want to sell their services. 😅

Bathing and grooming are very good. The price is worth it and the quality is excellent. You don't have to make your dog or cat wait long. Bathing and grooming are good. There are no wounds and the work is fast.
My dog ​​and two cats regularly come here for grooming, injections, treatments, and sterilization. It's a trustworthy hospital.
I often send my dog ​​there to get his hair cut. He does a great job, cuts it beautifully, and is very kind to the dog.
